{"metadata":{"description":"给 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web 界面加一个 VS Code 风格的工作区文件浏览器：右侧文件树 + 可编辑标签页 + Markdown 阅读/编辑/分屏 + 悬浮大纲 + Quick Open 搜索。","id":"gh:1333943782","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"Dsh-FileExplorer","slug":"bearllfleed/Dsh-FileExplorer","topics":["dsh-plugin","file","file-explorer"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"给 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web 界面加一个 VS Code 风格的工作区文件浏览器：右侧文件树 + 可编辑标签页 + Markdown 阅读/编辑/分屏 + 悬浮大纲 + Q"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"rness (DSH) Web 界面加一个 VS Code 风格的工作区文件浏览器：右侧文件树 + 可编辑标签页 + Markdown 阅读/编辑/分屏 + 悬浮大纲 + Quick Open 搜索。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-file-explorer"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A VS Code-style workspace file explorer for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI: right-side file tree "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"+ editable tabs + Markdown read/edit/split + floating outline + Quick Open."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **File tree**: right-side explorer with type-colored icons and collapsible folders; click a file t"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"o open it in the center area.
- **Right-click menu**: right-click the file tree → New File / New Fol"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"der / Rename / Delete / Copy Path (like the VS Code explorer).
- **Drag-and-drop move**: drag a file"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" or folder onto a folder to move it (like VS Code); open tabs update their path automatically when a"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" file is moved.
- **Import from your OS**: paste files copied in Finder / Windows Explorer (`⌘/Ctrl+"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"V`) or drag them in from the desktop — folders keep their structure and name clashes are auto-rename"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"d.
- **Editable tabs**: center tabs (after the conversation/trace tabs) with syntax highlighting, Ta"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"b indent, `⌘/Ctrl+S` save, hover `×` close, and a right-click menu (Close / Close Others / Close to "},{"id":"p6s9","text":"the Right / Close Saved / Close All / Copy Path / Pin).
- **Auto-save**: configurable "Off / After d"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"elay / On focus lost"; a confirm dialog guards closing unsaved files.
- **Markdown**: Typora/Obsidia"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"n-style "Read / Edit / Split" modes; a floating outline on the right in read mode that expands on ho"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"ver (like ChatGPT's hover bar).
- **Quick Open**: `⌘/Ctrl+P` fuzzy file search and open (same as VS "},{"id":"p6s13","text":"Code); also reachable via the magnifier button in the sidebar header.
- **i18n**: switches between C"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"hinese and English by following the DSH general setting.
- **Editor font**: customize the editor fon"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"t for opened files in the settings panel (monospace contexts).
- **Open chat files in-app**: clickin"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"g a file in the chat (a produced-file chip, an inline path mention, or a tool card's file link) open"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"s it in the explorer editor tab instead of the browser/Finder."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Explorer expanded**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Explorer collapsed**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**File settings**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**File search**"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Open file**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Markdown outline**"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Closing an unsaved file**"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> Requires DSH with an initialized `web` profile (auto-created on first `dsh web`)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"`dsh plugin` is DSH's built-in plugin manager; it forwards the arguments to pnpm inside the profile "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"directory. **Always use it, not `npm install -g`** — DSH loads plugins from `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"node_modules`, and it never reads the global directory (Windows `AppData\Roaming\npm`), so a global "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"install has no effect."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> Prerequisite: `dsh plugin` shells out to pnpm, so install pnpm first (`npm install -g pnpm`), othe"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"rwise it fails with `pnpm not found on PATH`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Option 1: install from npm"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Option 2: install from GitHub (no npm publish required)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Update"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Uninstall"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Check installed / latest version"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Then enable the plugin"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Installing only adds the package as a dependency; you must also register it in the profile's `cordis"},{"id":"p30s2","text":".patch.yml` so DSH loads it. Edit `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` and add:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"`id` is a unique identifier in the config tree (customizable); `name` must be the npm package name."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### Restart"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"> After install/update you must **fully quit and restart the `dsh web` process** (host routes are re"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"gistered at startup) and hard-refresh the page with `⌘/Ctrl+Shift+R` (the browser bundle is cached)."},{"id":"p35s3","text":" A plain page refresh won't pick up new features."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"### New features don't show up after updating?"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Check in order:"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"1. **DSH not fully restarted** — host routes (new file / rename / delete) are registered at process "},{"id":"p38s2","text":"startup; quit `dsh web` and start it again, not just refresh the page.
2. **Browser cache** — the ri"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"ght-click menu and drag-and-drop live in the browser bundle; hard-refresh or use an incognito window"},{"id":"p38s4","text":".
3. **Wrong location / wrong version** — `dsh plugin --profile web list dsh-plugin-file-explorer` s"},{"id":"p38s5","text":"hows the actually-loaded version; if it's an old one, it was likely installed with `npm install -g` "},{"id":"p38s6","text":"into the global directory (which DSH ignores). Re-run `dsh plugin --profile web add ...` above."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"| Action | Shortcut / entry |"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"| Toggle file tree | file icon in the right activity bar |
| Open a file | click in the tree; or `⌘/"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"Ctrl+P` then Enter |
| New / rename / delete | right-click menu in the tree |
| Move a file / folder"},{"id":"p41s3","text":" | drag it onto the target folder |
| Save | `⌘/Ctrl+S` |
| Close a tab | hover `×` on the tab, or r"},{"id":"p41s4","text":"ight-click menu |
| Markdown mode | "Read / Edit / Split" at the top of the file |
| Markdown outlin"},{"id":"p41s5","text":"e | hover the right floating bar in read mode |
| Editor font / auto-save | gear button in the sideb"},{"id":"p41s6","text":"he right floating bar in read mode |
| Editor font / auto-save | gear button in the sidebar header |"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"## Layout"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"After editing `lib/`, if the plugin is installed via a `file:` link, sync to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web"},{"id":"p45s2","text":"/node_modules/dsh-plugin-file-explorer/lib/`; otherwise re-run `dsh plugin add` and restart."},{"id":"p46s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
